input.question: What type of aircraft was involved in Flight 63?

documents.text: DC -Nashville- Los Angeles , crashed into the wooded summit of Glade Mountain about 6 miles ( 9.7 km ) southwest of the town of Rural Retreat , Virginia . Of the 22 occupants on board ( 19 passengers and three crewmembers ) , 17 were killed . The cause of the crash was determined to be pilot error in not properly remaining at a safe altitude .
